digest.component_or_area: LLM model configuration and class resolution
propositions: Add a three-slot config schema for model selection by capability tier (frontier, standard, trivial), each slot accepting model, provider, endpoint, and optional fallback array
Expose a resolver that maps class name to provider-qualified model string, inferring provider via infer_provider when omitted
Enforce secrets boundary: slots and fallback entries must not accept api_key; reject with typed config error if present
Implement load_class_slots entry point in model_classes.py to read and parse model_classes sub-table from merged [tool.rebar.llm] config, returning resolved slots with per-class defaults when unset
Fallback array is parsed and validated (non-recursive, no nested fallback keys) but not yet consumed at runtime; it is config-file-only with no env serialization form

Environment variables follow flat layering with per-field addressing (REBAR_LLM_CLASS_FIELD pattern), respecting existing precedence (CLI > env > file > default) without inventing merge rules for whole objects
